LanguageData.LP_NetherilAltar.label: Netherese altar
LanguageData.LP_NetherilAltar.description: A Netherese altar built of gold, mithril and plasteel. Whoever has read the Scroll of Karsus seven times can start the ascension ritual here. Also a meditation focus.
LanguageData.LP_LarlochOfferingBox.label: Larloch's offering chest
LanguageData.LP_LarlochOfferingBox.description: An offering chest left by Larloch's envoy that only accepts planar residue and miracle fragments. Once 20 planar residue and 3 miracle fragments are placed in it, the chest and its contents vanish together.
LanguageData.LP_PhylacteryCasket.label: phylactery casket
LanguageData.LP_PhylacteryCasket.description: A casket escorted by Larloch's skeletons, sealing a phylactery inside. Thay wants to seize it.
